text: Anthropic released Claude 4 as two models—Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4—in May 2025 to address different market segments within agentic coding, with the dual-model strategy positioning Sonnet 4 as a fast workhorse for routine development tasks alongside the flagship Opus 4 [Source: ev-1]. The launch signaled that the agentic-coding market had reached a critical inflection point defined by reliability and enterprise adoption rather than just raw capability [Source: ev-1].
